notes: Whole-file digests for everything DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.3 was forbidden to change: the probe execution engine and its worker, the typed-fact extractor, the production _classify_indent it measures, every authority and eligibility surface, OPS.VALIDATE.3, patch basis and safety, CONTROL ranking and RETRIEVE recall, and the sandbox/apply primitives it reuses.

AST digests for the DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.2 comparison-integrity rules. This phase added a companion-probe parameter and one closure status to core/candidate_defect_probe.py; what makes a comparison valid, what makes it stale, and how the managed sandbox is disposed of are pinned here so the addition cannot quietly relax any of them.
CONTROL.LOCALIZE.LIVE.2 pinned core/candidate_defect_probe.py by whole-file digest. That digest was re-pinned for this phase, and this fixture is the finer-grained invariant it used to carry.
patch_author_live2_repin_note: PATCH.AUTHOR.LIVE.2 (2026-09-10) is the phase authorised to move the patch-authoring contract: the candidate wire shape, the exact field names, the output-only rules and the safe_minimal identifier constraints now live in core/patch_authoring_contract.py, and the initial draft and the single verification-guided revision both render from there. core/control_engine.py moved for that reason and for no other. The initial-draft prompt is byte-identical across 82 configurations, and tests/fixtures/patch_author_live2_contract_reversal.json stores the hunks that reverse the change, so a test reconstructs the pre-LIVE.2 bytes from the shipped file and asserts the digest this note replaced.
